recipes.name: Kung pao chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) boneless chicken thighs, cut in 1/2 inch cubes
1 tablespoon soy sauce plus 1 tablespoon cornstarch, for the chicken
Sauce: 2 tablespoons soy sauce, 1 tablespoon black or rice vinegar, 1 tablespoon sugar, 1 teaspoon cornstarch, 3 tablespoons water
6 to 10 dried red chilies, cut in half (optional)
4 green onions, cut in 1/2 inch pieces
steps: Cut the chicken and slice the garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Mix the chicken with 1 tablespoon soy sauce and 1 tablespoon cornstarch. Wash your hands.
Stir the sauce ingredients together in a cup.
Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat and fry the chilies and peppercorns for 30 seconds, until fragrant. Don't let them burn.
Turn the heat to high, add the chicken and cook for 5 to 6 minutes, until golden and 165°F (74°C).
Add the garlic, ginger and green onions for 1 minute.
Stir the sauce again, pour it in and toss for 1 minute, until glossy.
Toss in the peanuts and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Sweet and sour chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) boneless chicken breast, cut in 1 inch pieces
1 red and 1 green bell pepper, cut in chunks
1 can (20 oz / 565 g) pineapple chunks, drained, 1/2 cup juice saved
1/3 cup (80 ml) rice or apple cider vinegar
1 tablespoon cornstarch mixed with 2 tablespoons water
steps: Cut the chicken and vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Sprinkle the chicken with salt, dip in egg, then toss in cornstarch. Wash your hands.
Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a big pan over medium-high heat and cook the chicken in batches for 5 to 6 minutes, turning, until golden and 165°F (74°C). Lift out.
Add the rest of the oil and cook the peppers and onion for 3 minutes.
Add the pineapple juice, ketchup, vinegar, sugar and soy sauce and bring to a simmer.
Stir in the cornstarch mix and cook for 1 minute, until thick.
Add the chicken and pineapple and toss. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Orange chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) boneless chicken thighs, cut in 1 inch pieces
Sauce: 3/4 cup (180 ml) orange juice, zest of 1 orange, 1/3 cup (65 g) brown sugar, 3 tablespoons soy sauce, 2 tablespoons rice vinegar
1 tablespoon cornstarch mixed with 2 tablespoons water
2 green onions, sliced, and sesame seeds
steps: Cut the chicken. Ask an adult to help.
Dip the chicken in egg, then toss in cornstarch and salt. Wash your hands.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium-high heat and cook the chicken in batches for 6 to 7 minutes, turning, until crispy and 165°F (74°C). Drain on paper towels.
Wipe the pan and add the sauce ingredients, garlic and ginger. Simmer for 3 minutes.
Stir in the cornstarch mix and cook for 1 minute, until thick and glossy.
Toss the chicken in the sauce and top with green onions and sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Beef and broccoli
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) flank steak, thinly sliced across the grain
1 tablespoon soy sauce plus 1 tablespoon cornstarch, for the beef
Sauce: 3 tablespoons oyster sauce, 1 tablespoon soy sauce, 1 tablespoon brown sugar, 1 teaspoon cornstarch, 1/2 cup (120 ml) water or broth
steps: Slice the beef thinly. It's easier if it's half frozen. Ask an adult to help.
Toss the beef with 1 tablespoon soy sauce and the cornstarch.
Mix the sauce ingredients in a cup.
Steam or boil the broccoli for 2 minutes, until bright green. Drain.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a wok over high heat and sear the beef in one layer for 1 to 2 minutes per side. Lift out.
Add the rest of the oil, garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Add the sauce and simmer for 1 minute, until thick.
Add the beef and broccoli and toss. Drizzle with sesame oil and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Mapo tofu
ingredients: 1 block (16 oz / 450 g) soft or medium tofu, cut in 1 inch cubes
6 oz (170 g) ground pork or beef
2 tablespoons doubanjiang (chili bean paste), or 1 tablespoon for less heat
1 cup (240 ml) chicken broth or water
1 tablespoon cornstarch mixed with 2 tablespoons water
steps: Cut the tofu gently and slide it into lightly salted simmering water for 2 minutes so it firms up. Drain. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a wok over medium-high heat and cook the pork for 3 to 4 minutes, until browned.
Add the doubanjiang, black beans, garlic and ginger and stir for 1 minute.
Add the broth, soy sauce and sugar and bring to a simmer.
Slide in the tofu and simmer for 4 minutes. Push it gently, don't stir hard.
Add the cornstarch mix in two parts and simmer for 1 minute, until thick.
Sprinkle with Sichuan pepper and green onions. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Chicken lo mein
ingredients: 12 oz (340 g) lo mein egg noodles or spaghetti
12 oz (340 g) boneless chicken, thinly sliced
1 cup (100 g) snow peas or bean sprouts
Sauce: 3 tablespoons soy sauce, 1 tablespoon oyster sauce, 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce (optional), 2 teaspoons sugar, 2 teaspoons sesame oil
steps: Boil the noodles as the package says. Drain and rinse with cold water.
Slice the chicken and vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Mix the sauce ingredients.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a wok over high heat and cook the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes, until 165°F (74°C). Lift out.
Add the rest of the oil and stir-fry the garlic, cabbage, carrot and snow peas for 2 to 3 minutes.
Add the noodles, chicken and sauce and toss for 2 minutes, until hot and coated.
Toss in the green onions and serve.

recipes.name: Crispy chow mein
ingredients: 12 oz (340 g) thin fresh chow mein noodles or steamed noodles
8 oz (225 g) chicken or shrimp, thinly sliced (optional)
Sauce: 2 tablespoons soy sauce, 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce, 1 tablespoon oyster sauce, 1 teaspoon sugar, 1 teaspoon sesame oil
steps: Loosen the noodles. If they're dry, boil them for 2 minutes and drain well.
Mix the sauce ingredients.

Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a big pan over medium-high heat. Spread the noodles flat and cook for 4 to 5 minutes, until crispy on the bottom. Flip and cook for 3 minutes more. An adult should help flip. Slide onto a plate.
Add the rest of the oil and cook the chicken for 4 minutes, until 165°F (74°C), or the shrimp for 2 minutes, until pink.
Add the garlic, cabbage and carrot for 2 minutes.
Add the bean sprouts, green onions and sauce and toss for 1 minute.
Pile the vegetables over the crispy noodles.

recipes.name: Oven char siu pork
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) pork shoulder or tenderloin, cut in long strips 2 inches thick
2 tablespoons honey, plus 2 tablespoons for glazing
steps: Mix the hoisin, soy sauce, 2 tablespoons honey, sugar, oyster sauce, five spice, garlic and food coloring.
Coat the pork and marinate in the fridge for at least 4 hours, or overnight. Wash your hands. Save some marinade in a separate cup for basting.
Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Put a rack over a foil-lined pan with 1 cup water in the pan.
Roast the pork on the rack for 25 minutes.
Brush with the saved marinade, flip, and roast for 20 minutes more, until 145°F (63°C) for tenderloin or 160°F (71°C) for shoulder.
Brush with honey and broil for 2 to 3 minutes, until sticky and charred at the edges. An adult should watch the broiler.
Rest for 10 minutes and slice. Serve with rice or in buns.

recipes.name: Chinese tomato and egg
steps: Beat the eggs with 1/4 teaspoon salt.
Cut the tomatoes into wedges. Ask an adult to help.
Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a wok over medium-high heat and scramble the eggs for 1 minute, until just set but still soft. Lift out.
Add the rest of the oil and the tomatoes and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, until soft and juicy.
Add the ketchup, sugar, water and the rest of the salt and simmer for 1 minute.
Add the eggs back and fold gently for 30 seconds.
Top with green onions and serve over rice.

recipes.name: Mongolian beef
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) flank steak, thinly sliced across the grain
6 green onions, cut in 2 inch pieces
steps: Slice the beef thinly. Ask an adult to help.
Toss the beef in cornstarch to coat.
Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a big pan over medium-high heat and fry the beef in batches for 2 minutes per side, until crispy. Lift out.
Add the rest of the oil, garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Add the soy sauce, water, sugar and chili flakes and simmer for 4 to 5 minutes, until a little thick.
Add the beef and green onions and toss for 1 minute. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Egg foo young
ingredients: 1/2 cup (75 g) diced cooked ham, chicken or shrimp
Gravy: 1 cup (240 ml) chicken broth, 1 tablespoon soy sauce, 1 tablespoon oyster sauce, 1 teaspoon sugar, 1 tablespoon cornstarch
steps: Beat the eggs with salt, then stir in the bean sprouts, ham, green onions and peas.
Whisk the gravy ingredients in a small pot and simmer for 2 minutes, stirring, until thick.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Ask an adult to help with the hot oil.
Pour in 1/2 cup of the egg mix and cook for 2 minutes, until set on the bottom.
Flip and cook for 1 to 2 minutes more. Repeat with the rest, adding oil as needed.
Pour the gravy over the omelets and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Cantonese steamed fish
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) white fish fillets like cod, sea bass or tilapia
2 inch piece ginger, cut in thin matchsticks
4 green onions, cut in thin strips
steps: Cut the ginger and green onions into thin strips. Ask an adult to help.
Put the fish on a heatproof plate, sprinkle with salt and top with half the ginger.
Set the plate on a rack in a wok or wide pot with boiling water underneath. Cover and steam for 8 to 10 minutes, until the fish flakes and is 145°F (63°C).
An adult lifts out the hot plate and pours off the liquid.
Warm the soy sauce, water and sugar and pour around the fish.
Top with the rest of the ginger, the green onions and cilantro.
An adult heats the oil until it just smokes and pours it over the green onions. It sizzles. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Hong shao rou red braised pork
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) skin-on pork belly, cut in 1 1/2 inch cubes
steps: Cut the pork. Ask an adult to help.
Put the pork in a pot of cold water, bring to a boil and boil for 3 minutes. Drain and rinse.
Heat the oil and sugar in a heavy pot over medium-low heat for 3 to 4 minutes, until it turns amber. An adult should do this, melted sugar is very hot.
Add the pork and stir for 2 minutes to coat.
Add the ginger, green onions, star anise, cinnamon, soy sauces, wine and hot water.
Cover and simmer on low for 1 hour, stirring now and then.
Uncover, turn up the heat and cook for 10 to 15 minutes, stirring, until the sauce is thick and sticky. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Taiwanese three cup chicken
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) boneless chicken thighs, cut in bite-size pieces
steps: Cut the chicken and slice the ginger. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the sesame oil in a wok or clay pot over medium heat and fry the ginger and garlic for 3 to 4 minutes, until golden.
Add the chilies and the chicken and cook for 5 minutes, until browned.
Add the soy sauces, rice wine and sugar.
Cover and simmer for 10 minutes, then uncover and cook for 3 to 5 minutes, until the sauce is sticky and the chicken is 165°F (74°C).
Turn off the heat and toss in the basil. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Lu rou fan braised pork rice
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) pork belly or shoulder, cut in small 1/4 inch pieces
1/2 cup (60 g) fried shallots, or 4 shallots sliced and fried
steps: Cut the pork into small pieces. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a pot over medium-high heat and cook the pork for 8 minutes, until it loses its pink and some fat melts.
Add the shallots and garlic for 2 minutes.
Add the soy sauces, rice wine, sugar and five spice and stir for 1 minute.
Add the water and eggs and bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer on low for 1 hour, stirring now and then, until the pork is very tender and the sauce is glossy.
Spoon the pork and sauce over rice with a halved egg on top.

recipes.name: Xinjiang cumin lamb
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) boneless lamb leg or shoulder, thinly sliced
steps: Slice the lamb thinly. It's easier when half frozen. Ask an adult to help.
Toss the lamb with soy sauce and cornstarch.
Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a wok over high heat and sear the lamb in batches for 2 minutes, until browned. Lift out.
Add the rest of the oil and the onion for 2 minutes.
Add the garlic, cumin and chili flakes for 30 seconds.
Add the lamb, salt and sugar and toss for 1 minute.
Toss in the cilantro and serve with rice or flatbread.

recipes.name: Chicken teriyaki
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) boneless skin-on or skinless chicken thighs
steps: Pat the chicken dry and sprinkle with salt.
Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium heat and put the chicken in skin side down.
Cook for 6 to 7 minutes, until golden. Flip and cook for 4 to 5 minutes more.
Mix the soy sauce, mirin, sake, sugar and ginger.
Wipe out extra fat, pour in the sauce and simmer for 3 to 4 minutes, spooning it over the chicken, until thick and glossy and the chicken is 165°F (74°C).
Slice the chicken. Ask an adult to help.
Top with sauce, sesame seeds and green onions. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Chicken katsu
ingredients: 2 large boneless chicken breasts, sliced in half to make 4 thin cutlets
1/2 cup (120 ml) vegetable oil for shallow frying
Katsu sauce: 1/4 cup (60 ml) ketchup, 2 tablespoons Worcestershire sauce, 1 tablespoon soy sauce, 1 tablespoon sugar
steps: Slice the chicken into thin cutlets. Ask an adult to help.
Season with salt and pepper. Coat in flour, then egg, then panko, pressing it on. Wash your hands.
Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium heat. An adult should do the frying.
Fry 2 cutlets at a time for 4 to 5 minutes per side, until golden and 165°F (74°C).
Drain on a rack and rest for 3 minutes.
Mix the katsu sauce.
Slice and serve with cabbage, rice and sauce.

recipes.name: Japanese chicken curry
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) boneless chicken thighs, cut in bite-size pieces
1 box (3.5 oz / 100 g) Japanese curry roux, mild or medium
steps: Cut the chicken and vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat and cook the onions for 5 minutes.
Add the chicken and cook for 4 minutes, until no longer pink outside.
Add the carrots, potatoes and water and bring to a boil. Skim off any foam.
Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, until the vegetables are tender and the chicken is 165°F (74°C).
Turn off the heat, break in the curry roux and stir until it melts.
Add the ketchup and honey and simmer on low for 5 minutes, stirring, until thick.
Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Gyudon beef bowl
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) very thinly sliced beef (shabu shabu or ribeye)
4 cups (740 g) cooked short grain rice
Pickled red ginger, green onions and soft boiled eggs to serve
steps: Slice the onion. Ask an adult to help.
Simmer the dashi, soy sauce, mirin, sugar and sake in a pan.
Add the onion and simmer for 5 minutes, until soft.
Add the beef, pulling the slices apart, and simmer for 2 to 3 minutes, until cooked through. Skim any foam.
Spoon the beef, onion and some broth over bowls of rice.
Top with pickled ginger, green onions and an egg.

recipes.name: Oyakodon chicken and egg bowl
ingredients: 8 oz (225 g) boneless chicken thighs, cut in small pieces
2 cups (370 g) cooked short grain rice
steps: Cut the chicken and onion. Ask an adult to help.
Simmer the dashi, soy sauce, mirin and sugar in a small frying pan.
Add the onion and chicken and simmer for 6 to 7 minutes, until the chicken is 165°F (74°C).
Pour the eggs over in a circle. Cover and cook on low for 1 to 2 minutes, until just set but still soft.
Slide over bowls of hot rice and top with green onion.

recipes.name: Tonkatsu pork cutlet
ingredients: 4 boneless pork loin chops, 1/2 inch (1.3 cm) thick
Vegetable oil for frying, about 1 inch (2.5 cm) deep
Shredded cabbage, lemon wedges and rice
steps: Snip the fat on the edges of the chops so they stay flat. Pound lightly. Ask an adult to help.
Season, then coat in flour, egg and panko. Wash your hands.
An adult heats the oil in a deep pan to 340°F (170°C). Hot oil is dangerous, so an adult does the frying.
Fry 2 chops at a time for 3 to 4 minutes per side, until golden and 145°F (63°C).
Drain on a rack and rest for 3 minutes.
Slice and serve with cabbage, rice, lemon and sauce.

recipes.name: Teriyaki salmon
ingredients: Sesame seeds, green onions and rice
steps: Pat the salmon dry and sprinkle with salt.
Mix the soy sauce, mirin, honey, sake and ginger.
Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the salmon skin side down for 4 minutes.
Flip and cook for 2 to 3 minutes.
Pour in the sauce and simmer for 1 to 2 minutes, spooning it over, until thick and the salmon is 145°F (63°C).
Top with sesame seeds and green onions. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Oven yakitori chicken skewers
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) boneless chicken thighs, cut in 1 inch pieces
1 bunch green onions (white and light green parts), cut in 1 inch pieces
Tare sauce: 1/3 cup (80 ml) soy sauce, 1/3 cup (80 ml) mirin, 2 tablespoons sake or water, 2 tablespoons sugar
steps: Simmer the tare ingredients in a small pot for 8 to 10 minutes, until slightly syrupy. Save a little in a separate cup for serving.
Cut the chicken and green onions. Ask an adult to help.
Thread chicken and green onion pieces onto the skewers, switching between them. Wash your hands.
Heat the broiler to high with the rack 6 inches from the heat. An adult should do this.
Broil the skewers on a foil-lined pan for 5 minutes per side.
Brush with tare and broil for 1 to 2 minutes more per side, until glazed and 165°F (74°C).
Brush with the saved tare and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Nikujaga meat and potatoes
ingredients: 8 oz (225 g) thinly sliced beef or pork
1/2 cup (50 g) snow peas or green beans
steps: Cut the vegetables and beef. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat and cook the beef for 2 minutes. Add the onion for 2 minutes.
Add the potatoes, carrot and dashi and bring to a boil. Skim the foam.
Add the sugar, mirin and sake and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, lay a small lid or foil right on top of the food, and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, until the potatoes are tender.
Add the snow peas for 2 minutes. Let it sit for 10 minutes so the flavors soak in.

recipes.name: Chicken karaage
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) boneless chicken thighs, cut in 1 1/2 inch pieces
3/4 cup (95 g) potato starch or cornstarch
Vegetable oil for frying, about 1 1/2 inches (4 cm) deep
steps: Cut the chicken. Ask an adult to help.
Mix the chicken with soy sauce, sake, ginger, garlic and sesame oil. Marinate for 30 minutes. Wash your hands.
Toss the chicken in potato starch until coated.
An adult heats the oil in a deep pot to 340°F (170°C). Hot oil is dangerous, so an adult does all the frying.
Fry in batches for 4 minutes. Lift out and rest for 4 minutes.
Heat the oil to 375°F (190°C) and fry again for 1 minute, until extra crispy and 165°F (74°C).
Drain and serve with lemon and mayo.

recipes.name: Hambagu Japanese hamburger steak
ingredients: 1/2 cup (25 g) panko soaked in 3 tablespoons milk
1 lb (450 g) ground beef, or half beef and half pork
Sauce: 1/4 cup (60 ml) ketchup, 3 tablespoons Worcestershire sauce, 2 tablespoons water, 1 tablespoon butter
steps: Chop the onion. Ask an adult to help.
Cook the onion in the butter over medium heat for 6 to 8 minutes, until soft and golden. Let it cool.
Mix the meat, onion, soaked panko, egg, salt, pepper and nutmeg. Wash your hands.
Shape into 4 oval patties about 3/4 inch thick and press a dip in the middle.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat and cook the patties for 4 minutes, until browned. Flip.
Add 2 tablespoons water, cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 minutes, until 160°F (71°C) inside.
Lift out the patties, add the sauce ingredients to the pan and simmer for 1 minute. Pour over the patties.

recipes.name: Beef bulgogi
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) ribeye or sirloin, very thinly sliced
Sesame seeds, rice and lettuce leaves
steps: Slice the beef very thinly. It's easier when half frozen. Ask an adult to help.
Mix the soy sauce, pear, sugar, sesame oil, garlic, ginger and pepper.
Add the beef, onion and green onions and marinate for 30 minutes. Wash your hands.
Heat the oil in a big pan over high heat.
Cook the beef in batches for 2 to 3 minutes, until browned and cooked through.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve with rice and lettuce for wrapping.

recipes.name: Bibimbap
ingredients: 4 cups (740 g) cooked short grain rice
8 oz (225 g) ground beef or thinly sliced beef
2 tablespoons sesame oil, divided, plus more for serving
Sauce: 3 tablespoons gochujang, 1 tablespoon sesame oil, 1 tablespoon sugar, 1 tablespoon water
steps: Cut the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Mix the beef with 1 tablespoon soy sauce, the sugar, 1 tablespoon sesame oil and garlic. Cook in a pan over medium-high heat for 5 minutes, until browned.
Blanch the spinach and bean sprouts in boiling water for 1 minute each. Drain and squeeze. Toss each with a little sesame oil and soy sauce.
Cook the carrot and zucchini separately in the vegetable oil for 2 minutes each, until just soft.
Fry the eggs for 2 to 3 minutes, keeping the yolks runny if you like.
Mix the sauce ingredients.
Put rice in each bowl and arrange the beef and vegetables on top in groups. Add an egg.
Add sauce and sesame seeds, then mix it all together to eat.

recipes.name: Korean fried chicken
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) chicken wings or boneless thigh pieces
3/4 cup (95 g) potato starch or cornstarch
Vegetable oil for frying, about 2 inches (5 cm) deep
Sauce: 3 tablespoons gochujang, 3 tablespoons honey, 2 tablespoons ketchup, 1 tablespoon soy sauce, 3 garlic cloves grated, 1 tablespoon butter
steps: Season the chicken with salt, pepper and ginger. Toss in the starch. Wash your hands.
An adult heats the oil in a deep pot to 350°F (175°C). Hot oil is dangerous, so an adult does the frying.
Fry in batches for 8 to 10 minutes for wings or 5 to 6 minutes for boneless. Lift out and rest for 5 minutes.
Fry again at 375°F (190°C) for 2 to 3 minutes, until very crispy and 165°F (74°C).
Simmer the sauce ingredients in a big pan for 2 minutes, until bubbly.
Toss the chicken in the sauce and top with sesame seeds and peanuts.

recipes.name: Dak galbi spicy chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) boneless chicken thighs, cut in bite-size pieces
Sauce: 3 tablespoons gochujang, 1 tablespoon gochugaru (optional), 2 tablespoons soy sauce, 1 tablespoon sugar, 1 tablespoon honey, 3 garlic cloves grated, 1 teaspoon grated ginger
3 cups (210 g) cabbage, cut in pieces
steps: Cut the chicken and vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Mix the sauce, add the chicken and marinate for 20 minutes. Wash your hands.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium heat.
Add the cabbage, sweet potato, onion and rice cakes, then the chicken on top.
Cook for 12 to 15 minutes, stirring often, until the sweet potato is tender and the chicken is 165°F (74°C).
Add the perilla leaves. For cheesy dak galbi, sprinkle on mozzarella, cover and cook for 2 minutes, until melted.

recipes.name: Galbi jjim braised short ribs
ingredients: 3 lb (1.4 kg) bone-in beef short ribs, cut in 2 inch pieces
1 daikon radish or 2 potatoes, cut in chunks
steps: Soak the ribs in cold water for 30 minutes to draw out blood, then drain.
Boil the ribs in a pot of water for 5 minutes. Drain and rinse. Ask an adult to help with the hot water.
Mix the soy sauce, pear, onion, sugar, honey, garlic, ginger and sesame oil.
Put the ribs, sauce and 3 cups water in a heavy pot and bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer on low for 1 hour 15 minutes.
Add the carrots, daikon, mushrooms, chestnuts and jujubes and simmer for 30 to 40 minutes, until the meat is very tender.
Uncover and simmer for 10 minutes to thicken the sauce. Skim off fat and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Jeyuk bokkeum spicy pork
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) pork shoulder or belly, very thinly sliced
Sauce: 3 tablespoons gochujang, 1 tablespoon gochugaru, 2 tablespoons soy sauce, 1 tablespoon sugar, 1 tablespoon honey, 1 tablespoon sesame oil, 4 garlic cloves grated, 1 teaspoon grated ginger
steps: Slice the pork and vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Mix the sauce and toss the pork in it. Marinate for 20 minutes. Wash your hands.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium-high heat.
Add the pork, onion and carrot and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring, until the pork is cooked through and a little charred.
Toss in the green onions for 1 minute.
Top with sesame seeds and serve with rice and lettuce for wrapping.

recipes.name: Dakdoritang spicy braised chicken
ingredients: Sauce: 2 tablespoons gochujang, 2 tablespoons gochugaru, 3 tablespoons soy sauce, 1 tablespoon sugar, 5 garlic cloves grated, 1 teaspoon grated ginger
steps: Cut the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Boil the chicken in water for 3 minutes, drain and rinse. This keeps the stew clear.
Mix the sauce ingredients.
Put the chicken, sauce and 2 cups water in a pot and bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the potatoes, carrot and onion and simmer for 20 to 25 minutes, until tender and the chicken is 165°F (74°C).
Add the green onions and sesame oil. Serve with rice. Use less gochugaru for milder heat.

recipes.name: Korean ground beef bowl
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon chili flakes or 1 teaspoon gochujang (optional)
Rice, cucumber, sesame seeds and fried eggs to serve
steps: Chop the garlic and slice the green onions. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium-high heat and cook the beef for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned. Drain the fat.
Add the garlic and ginger for 1 minute.
Add the soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil and chili and simmer for 2 minutes.
Stir in most of the green onions.
Spoon over rice and top with cucumber, sesame seeds, the rest of the green onions and an egg.

recipes.name: Huli huli chicken
ingredients: Grilled pineapple and green onions to serve
steps: Whisk the pineapple juice, soy sauce, sugar, ketchup, ginger, garlic and sriracha. Save 1 cup in a separate pot for the glaze.
Pour the rest over the chicken and marinate in the fridge for at least 2 hours. Wash your hands.
Simmer the saved cup for 8 to 10 minutes, until syrupy.
Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C) or heat a grill to medium-high. An adult should run the grill.
Lay the chicken on a foil-lined pan and bake for 20 minutes, or grill for 5 to 6 minutes per side.
Brush with glaze and bake for 5 minutes more, until sticky and 165°F (74°C).
Serve with pineapple and green onions.

recipes.name: Slow cooker kalua pork
ingredients: 4 to 5 lb (1.8 to 2.3 kg) boneless pork shoulder
1 tablespoon coarse Hawaiian or sea salt
Rice and macaroni salad to serve
steps: Poke the pork all over with a fork and tuck in the garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Rub the salt all over the pork. Wash your hands.
Put the pork in the slow cooker and pour the liquid smoke and water over it.
Cover and cook on low for 9 to 10 hours, until it falls apart.
If you're using cabbage, add it for the last 30 to 45 minutes.
Shred the pork with two forks and stir it into the juices. Taste and add more salt if needed.

recipes.name: Slow cooker honey garlic chicken
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cornstarch mixed with 3 tablespoons water
Sesame seeds, green onions and rice
steps: Chop the garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Put the chicken in the slow cooker.
Whisk the honey, soy sauce, ketchup, garlic, ginger and chili flakes and pour over.
Cover and cook on low for 4 hours, or on high for 2 hours 30 minutes, until 165°F (74°C).
Lift out the chicken. Stir the cornstarch mix into the sauce, cover and cook on high for 10 to 15 minutes, until thick.
Shred or slice the chicken, toss in the sauce, and top with sesame seeds and green onions.

recipes.name: Slow cooker teriyaki chicken
ingredients: 2 1/2 lb (1.1 kg) boneless chicken thighs or breasts
1/4 cup (60 ml) water or pineapple juice
3 tablespoons cornstarch mixed with 3 tablespoons water
Rice, steamed broccoli and sesame seeds
steps: Chop the garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Put the chicken in the slow cooker.
Whisk the soy sauce, sugar, vinegar, water, garlic and ginger and pour over.
Cover and cook on low for 4 hours, or on high for 2 hours 30 minutes, until 165°F (74°C).
Lift out the chicken and shred it.
Stir the cornstarch mix into the sauce, cover and cook on high for 10 to 15 minutes, until thick.
Toss the chicken in the sauce and serve over rice with broccoli.

recipes.name: Slow cooker beef ragu
ingredients: 3 lb (1.4 kg) boneless beef chuck roast, cut in 4 pieces
1/2 cup (120 ml) beef broth or red wine
2 bay leaves and 1 teaspoon dried oregano
steps: Chop the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Season the beef and brown it in the oil in a big pan over medium-high heat for 3 minutes per side. Put it in the slow cooker.
Cook the onion, carrots and celery in the same pan for 5 minutes. Add the garlic and tomato paste for 1 minute.
Add everything to the slow cooker with the tomatoes, broth, bay leaves and oregano.
Cover and cook on low for 8 hours, until the beef shreds easily.
Shred the beef in the sauce with two forks and take out the bay leaves.
Boil the pasta as the package says, toss with the ragu and top with parmesan.

recipes.name: Slow cooker chile verde
ingredients: 3 lb (1.4 kg) boneless pork shoulder, cut in 2 inch chunks
1 lb (450 g) tomatillos, husked and halved
Tortillas, rice and lime to serve
steps: Chop the peppers and onion. Ask an adult to help.
Blend the tomatillos, poblanos, jalapeno, onion, garlic, cilantro and broth until fairly smooth.
Season the pork with salt, cumin and oregano and put it in the slow cooker. Wash your hands.
Pour the sauce over the pork.
Cover and cook on low for 8 hours, until the pork falls apart.
Break up the pork a little and serve with tortillas, rice and lime.

recipes.name: Air fryer chicken tenders
ingredients: Honey mustard or ketchup for dipping
steps: Season the chicken with salt, garlic powder and paprika.
Mix the panko and parmesan.
Coat each tender in flour, then egg, then panko, pressing it on. Wash your hands.
Lay in the air fryer basket in one layer and spray with oil.
Air fry at 400°F (200°C) for 10 to 12 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and 165°F (74°C).
Serve with dipping sauce.

recipes.name: Air fryer chicken wings
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) chicken wings, split into flats and drums
1/2 cup (120 ml) buffalo, barbecue or honey garlic sauce
steps: Pat the wings very dry with paper towels.
Toss with baking powder, salt, garlic powder and pepper. Wash your hands.
Lay in the air fryer basket in one layer.
Air fry at 380°F (195°C) for 12 minutes. Flip.
Turn up to 400°F (200°C) and air fry for 8 to 10 minutes more, until crispy and 165°F (74°C).
Toss with your favorite sauce and serve with celery and ranch.

recipes.name: Air fryer salmon
steps: Pat the salmon dry and brush with oil.
Mix the paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper and sprinkle on top. Drizzle with honey.
Lay the salmon skin side down in the air fryer basket.
Air fry at 400°F (200°C) for 7 to 9 minutes, until it flakes and is 145°F (63°C).
Serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.name: Air fryer pork chops
ingredients: 4 boneless pork chops, about 1 inch (2.5 cm) thick
steps: Pat the pork chops dry and rub with oil.
Mix the sugar and spices and rub on both sides. Wash your hands.
Lay in the air fryer basket in one layer.
Air fry at 400°F (200°C) for 10 to 12 minutes, flipping halfway, until 145°F (63°C).
Rest for 5 minutes before cutting.

recipes.name: Air fryer fish sticks
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) cod or other firm white fish, cut in 1 x 3 inch strips
Tartar sauce and lemon to serve
steps: Cut the fish into strips. Ask an adult to help.
Season the fish with salt. Mix the panko, paprika and garlic powder.
Coat each strip in flour, egg, then panko. Wash your hands.
Lay in the air fryer basket in one layer and spray with oil.
Air fry at 400°F (200°C) for 8 to 10 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and 145°F (63°C).
Serve with tartar sauce and lemon.

recipes.name: Air fryer coconut shrimp
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) large shrimp, peeled and deveined, tails on
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and sprinkle with salt.
Mix the coconut and panko.
Coat each shrimp in flour, egg, then the coconut mix. Wash your hands.
Lay in the air fryer basket in one layer and spray with oil.
Air fry at 390°F (200°C) for 8 to 10 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and pink inside.
Serve with sweet chili sauce.

recipes.name: Crispy tofu and vegetables
ingredients: 1 block (14 oz / 400 g) extra firm tofu, pressed for 15 minutes
Sauce: 3 tablespoons soy sauce, 2 tablespoons maple syrup or honey, 1 tablespoon rice vinegar, 1 teaspoon sesame oil, 1 teaspoon cornstarch, 1/4 cup (60 ml) water
steps: Press the tofu between towels under a heavy pan for 15 minutes, then cut in cubes. Ask an adult to help cut the vegetables.
Toss the tofu in cornstarch.
Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a big pan over medium-high heat and fry the tofu for 8 to 10 minutes, turning, until crispy on all sides. Lift out.
Add the rest of the oil and stir-fry the broccoli, pepper and carrot for 4 minutes. Add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Mix the sauce, pour it in and cook for 1 minute, until thick.
Toss in the tofu and top with sesame seeds. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Air fryer crispy tofu
ingredients: 1 block (14 oz / 400 g) extra firm tofu, pressed for 15 minutes
Peanut sauce or sweet chili sauce for dipping
steps: Press the tofu for 15 minutes and cut in 1 inch cubes. Ask an adult to help.
Toss the tofu with soy sauce, oil and garlic powder.
Sprinkle with cornstarch and toss gently until coated.
Lay in the air fryer basket in one layer.
Air fry at 400°F (200°C) for 12 to 15 minutes, shaking halfway, until crispy.
Serve with dipping sauce, over rice or in a bowl with vegetables.

recipes.name: Egg roll in a bowl
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) ground pork, chicken or turkey
steps: Chop the garlic and slice the green onions. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium-high heat and cook the meat for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned and cooked through (165°F / 74°C for chicken or turkey).
Add the garlic and ginger for 1 minute.
Add the coleslaw mix, soy sauce, vinegar and sriracha and cook for 4 to 5 minutes, until the cabbage is just tender.
Top with green onions and sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Sweet potato black bean tacos
ingredients: 2 sweet potatoes, peeled and cut in 1/2 inch cubes
1 can (15 oz / 425 g) black beans, drained
Crumbled cotija or feta, cilantro and lime
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Cut the sweet potatoes. Ask an adult to help.
Toss with oil, spices and salt and spread on a sheet pan.
Roast for 20 to 25 minutes, stirring once, until tender and browned.
Warm the black beans in a small pot for 3 minutes.
Warm the tortillas and fill with sweet potato, beans, avocado, cheese, cilantro and a squeeze of lime.

recipes.name: Stuffed sweet potatoes
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz / 425 g) black beans, drained
1 cup (100 g) shredded cheddar or pepper jack
Sour cream, green onions and avocado to serve
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Prick the sweet potatoes with a fork and bake on a sheet pan for 45 to 50 minutes, until soft.
Mix the beans, corn, salsa, cumin and salt.
An adult splits the hot potatoes open. Fluff the inside with a fork.
Spoon the bean mix in and top with cheese.
Bake for 5 to 8 minutes more, until the cheese melts.
Top with sour cream, green onions and avocado.

recipes.name: Lentil bolognese
ingredients: 1 cup (200 g) brown or green lentils, rinsed
1 teaspoon dried oregano and 1 bay leaf
steps: Chop the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat and cook the onion, carrot and celery for 8 minutes.
Add the garlic and tomato paste for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, tomatoes, broth, oregano, bay leaf and salt and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 30 to 35 minutes, stirring now and then, until the lentils are tender and the sauce is thick.
Boil the pasta as the package says and toss with the sauce. Top with parmesan and basil.

recipes.name: Sheet pan chicken and vegetables
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) boneless chicken thighs or breasts, cut in 1 1/2 inch pieces
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Cut the chicken and vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Toss the potatoes with 1 tablespoon oil and a pinch of salt and roast for 15 minutes.
Toss the chicken, broccoli and onion with the rest of the oil and the seasonings. Wash your hands.
Add them to the pan with the potatoes and roast for 20 to 22 minutes, until the chicken is 165°F (74°C).
Squeeze the lemon over everything.
